CampaignWizard.newDescription.en: Each step is saved when you press Next.
CampaignWizard.newDescription.ar: تُحفظ كل خطوة عند الضغط على التالي.

CampaignWizard.newDescription.it: Ogni passaggio viene salvato quando premi Avanti.

CampaignWizard.editDescription.en: Editing a saved campaign. Each step is saved when you press Next.

CampaignWizard.lockedHint.de: Speichern Sie zuerst die vorherigen Schritte

CampaignWizard.cancelImpactSaved.en: Your draft is saved. You can continue it from the campaign's page.
CampaignWizard.cancelImpactSaved.ar: مسودتك محفوظة. يمكنك متابعتها من صفحة الحملة.

CampaignWizard.cancelImpactSaved.it: La bozza è salvata. Puoi riprenderla dalla pagina della campagna.

CampaignWizard.leave.body.en: This step has changes that aren't saved yet.

CampaignWizard.noAccessTitle.en: You can't create or edit campaigns

CampaignWizard.noAccessReadOnly.en: You're viewing as someone else: nothing can be changed in this session.

CampaignWizard.notFoundBody.en: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another project. Start a new one from Campaigns.

CampaignWizard.loadErrorTitle.de: Diese Kampagne konnte nicht geladen werden
